name: Light Paneer Butter Masala
ingredients: ¼ cup (60 g) silken tofu, for creaminess
steps: Heat the oil and cook onion, garlic and ginger for 5 minutes. Add the tomatoes and cook for 10 minutes until completely soft.
Cool slightly and blend with the silken tofu to a smooth, creamy sauce.
Return to the pan with the chilli, coriander powder and ½ cup water. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the paneer and simmer for 3 minutes. Do not overcook, or it turns rubbery.
Finish with garam masala, kasuri methi and salt.
note: The silken tofu replaces butter and cream, cutting saturated fat while keeping the sauce rich.
